seo.title: Coaching – Luis Schulz
seo.description: Personal triathlon coaching: training planned in TrainingPeaks and adjusted daily when needed. I reply within 3 hours, every day between 6am and 10pm.

title: Coaching
lead: I'm interested in sports science, but above all I'm interested in people. Finding the right approach for each athlete gives me a lot of joy. That's why I deliberately coach only a few and want to know each of them well. I planned my own path from my first run to my first long distance in 8:40 hours entirely by myself.

offer.title: 1:1 Coaching
offer.text: I plan your training in TrainingPeaks, look at your sessions and we stay in touch. If you're tired, have a last-minute business trip or feel really good, I adjust the plan. Day by day if needed.
features: I plan your training individually in TrainingPeaks
When needed, I adjust the plan every day
I'm available daily from 6am to 10pm and reply within 3 hours
I review your training data regularly
We plan your season and races together
Before each race we talk through pacing, nutrition and tactics
offer.note: I only take on a few athletes so I have enough time for each of them.

philosophyText:
What matters to me is sustainable development in sport. That's why I prefer to work with my athletes over the long term. Only then can health and athletic development go hand in hand.

In training this means: the easy days are truly easy. The hard days are hard, but in a way you can sustain over time.
philosophyQuote: Keep the easy days easier than easy and the hard days sustainably hard.

process.title: We get to know each other
process.text: In a free intro call you tell me where you are and where you want to go. And I tell you how I work.

process.title: I look at your training
process.text: If you already train with a watch or bike computer, I review your data.

process.title: We get going
process.text: You get your plan in TrainingPeaks and load sessions straight to your watch and bike computer.

process.title: We keep at it
process.text: You give me feedback and I adjust. That's what makes the difference in the end.

faq.question: How quickly do you reply?
faq.answer: Within 3 hours, every day between 6am and 10pm.

faq.question: Why do you coach only a few athletes?
faq.answer: Because I want to know each of them. I want to notice when something is getting too much before it shows up in the data. That only works if we talk regularly.

faq.question: How long do we work together?
faq.answer: Ideally for the long term. Sustainable progress takes time, and the longer we work together, the better I know you and what works for you.

faq.question: Why TrainingPeaks?
faq.answer: Because it simply works. You see your sessions on your phone, they sync to your watch and I can see straight after training how it went.

faq.question: What does day-by-day planning mean?
faq.answer: When your life needs it, I don't plan the whole week ahead. We look at what makes sense each day.

faq.question: Who is the coaching for?
faq.answer: Anyone who takes triathlon seriously and wants close support. Whether you're just starting out or planning your next full distance.
